2. None appeared on behalf of the petitioners to press this petition nor any request for adjournment
or pass over has been made whereas learned A.G.A. for the State is present.
3.

Learned A.G.A. on the basis of instructions received from Sri Rajesh Kumar, In-charge Inspector,
police station Sadarpur, district Sitapur submits that the charge-sheet no. 205/2024 against petitioner no. 1 Amrish Kumar @ Chhotu under Section 376/506 I.P.C. was forwarded to the concerned court on 22.7.2024 and the same was submitted in the concerned court on 5.9.2024,
however names of the petitioner nos. 2, 3 and 4 have been dropped during investigation.
4. In view of the above, this petition has been rendered infructuous.
(Zafeer Ahmad,J.) (Rajnish Kumar,J.) November 4, 2025 kanhaiya  Amrish Kumar @ Chhotu And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
